# Which base weapon plus catalyst pairs evolve early and how strong are they

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | build |
| Result | confirmed |
| Created | L1.I4 |
| Updated | L1.I10 |

## Hypothesis

A weapon at max level plus its catalyst evolves at the first chest. Fry-sentry at level 8 with slow-cooker evolves into Fry Fortress within the first minutes and deals far more than the base weapon.

## Method

Fresh Nightmare 1 game on seed 11 for 180 s with fry-sentry 8, gravy-boat 1 and slow-cooker 1. Check the evolution time, damage by weapon, kills and health.

## Findings

A max-level weapon with its catalyst evolves at the first chest within about 55-130 s: Fry Fortress 56 s, Gratin Arc 70 s, Hash Harrier 67 s, Pressure Cooker 64 s, Peel Poltergeist 127 s (weak). Evolutions were the top damage sources. This only held when the loadout was handed over or a chest was opened early. Fresh starts on new seeds often did not evolve before dying, and on Nightmare 20 the same loadouts died with no chest.
